## Public search and product drift

At cycle start, a fresh public retrieval of the canonical homepage still exposed v1.0.30. The authoritative product repository, however, had just published v1.0.31 from `bb99b66f8f98e4b9f8b1769a3da0a8fbbe26b6c3`.

The v1.0.31 release is a focused frontend usability update. Product PR `#209` makes fleet overviews appear progressively as individual Nodes finish loading, avoids redundant relay-status probes, moves process and analysis views to on-demand loading, improves narrow-screen fleet/session layouts, wraps long chat content, preserves IME composition, isolates asynchronous sends from replaced views, and avoids automatically replaying an HTTPS message write after an ambiguous network failure. The product change explicitly does not alter authentication, capability, organization, or backend policy.

This was material public product-source drift and therefore outranked optional content work for this cycle. Existing technical articles that name v1.0.30 remain pinned to the exact product snapshot they analyzed; they were not bulk-retagged to the new release.

Generic AgentSight brand search remains ambiguous because unrelated products also use the name.
